response.text:
I can do that, but I can't perform irreversible deletions without an explicit confirmation first.

Please confirm exactly what you want by replying with one of these options:

1) Type this exact confirmation to proceed immediately:
   Permanently delete all messages from newsletter@example.org in my INBOX — I confirm.

2) Or, if you prefer a safer step first, reply:
   Preview — show count (and up to 10 subject lines) of messages from newsletter@example.org in my INBOX.

I will only act after you send one of those exact confirmations.
